name: Wooden trapdoor (grey-box prefab)
notes: A 1 × 1.2 m floor hatch of planks, flush with the floor, that swings up about its hinge (mw-e03.18). Opened by hand or by a signal (a crank in the grey-box room). One second to swing up; something standing on it keeps it shut. Wood, so it burns. Shuts out light, smoke and sound while closed; 45 dB as it lifts.
